title: 十三张难度档位卡底框
intendedUse: 十三张专属子厅的统一难度卡片底图；档位名、金币上下限和人数由 H5 绘制
prompt: Create one empty landscape room-tier card panel for a dedicated Shisanshui card room. Match the dark emerald felt, ink-teal shadows, warm ivory edge and restrained polished-gold trim of the game-specific style. Stylized 3D casual-game material, rounded bevels and soft upper-left light. Keep the middle 75 percent flat, dark and uncluttered for dynamic text; make the outer rim distinctive but generic so the same artwork supports every difficulty level. No icons, ranks, coins, numbers, text or game results.
negativePrompt: bright external lobby style, multiple panels, text, letters, numbers, ranks, suits, chips, cash, photorealism, noisy ornament, watermark, UI screenshot

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Match only the dedicated game-room palette, material finish and lighting.
